meaning: Current production source census with lexical state candidates and model links. A mapping is not a complete branch or semantic refinement proof. Pending is unfinished review work.
exclusions: Dependencies, generated build outputs, test/fixture trees, declarations and integration test entry points are not production state machines. Generated registry source remains inventoried through its generator.

sources.statelessReason: D1 interfaces and pure exception classification; owns no data, counters, cache, timer or transition. The DB writes are covered at their callers.
Pure URL/header/Link parsing and cryptographic JWT construction from explicit inputs. No cached credential or persisted OAuth flow is held here; token validity and use belong to identity callers.

Pure mapping from supplied assessment artifacts/findings to safe location and fixed user-facing text; no state, I/O, current time, authority or persistence. Disposition and admission gates remain in separate models.
Event and error declarations only; no executable state transition.
Interface declaration only; UUPS callers are modeled in evm_proxy_lifecycle.
Interface getter signature only; no executable implementation or owned state.
Custom error declarations only; call refusal is modeled at callers.
Pure storage-pointer constructors, with no writes in their bodies. Reads and writes through returned pointers belong to proxy callers.
Type-only interface for finalized vault counters. No emitted runtime state; actual atomic reads, identity and reconciliation belong to the EVM/Solana adapters.
Re-exports the stateless response middleware; no independent transition.

Transforms one successful HTML response by request host and otherwise passes it through. No cross-request data, authorization state, timer, persistent write or cache is owned here. Transform/deployed-byte behavior still needs artifact tests.
Per-invocation platform/path discovery selects a Bash executable without launching it or retaining state; installer/executor callers own the process lifecycle.
Per-invocation environment projection with explicit overrides. It neither launches a process nor changes the parent environment; process authority belongs to callers.
Pure advisory string classifier over supplied discussion bodies/completeness. No state persists, and no moderation, scoring or payment action is performed.
Pure per-call diff/count/digest classifier. It retains no state or files and emits advisory flags, not scoring or payment decisions.
Compile-time connection and page-info interfaces only; collection progress is modeled in github_census.
Static excluded-directory names shared by proof snapshot and inventory scanners; no updates or cross-call state transition.
Pure directory-containment predicate over supplied paths/path API. File mutation and cleanup lifecycles belong to its callers.

Read-only selection and digest/identity validation over the ordered generated project-revision snapshot. Produces no revision or publication; it assumes upstream snapshot ordering rather than maintaining independent project state.

Reads and validates one committed protocol identity record against exact legacy/current identifier constants and disabled-activation schema; returns the supplied record or throws. No state mutation, migration, publication or authority lookup occurs; historical immutability is a repository policy outside this validator.

Pure retained/current census validation wrapper over supplied profile data and canonical repository inventory. It does not fetch, persist, publish or mutate profiles; current-vs-retained admission is enforced by its existing validators.
Pure bounded-input Markdown/installer-command rendering and argument parsing. It performs no installation, download, activation or write; generated command state is modeled at the actual installer.

Pure schema, hash and Ed25519 verification of supplied receipt bytes. It has no keys, persistence or state transition; a valid signature establishes byte/key continuity only. Receipt completion and upload lifecycles are modeled separately.
Pure content digest helper. It owns no durable, asynchronous or UI lifecycle state; callers model the trust placed in the digest.
Pure rendering of network/icon props. No local state, lifecycle effect, storage, or request.
Pure funding-status label from props. Domain funding transitions belong to backend/contract models.
Pure SVG and wordmark rendering. No application state or external side effect.
Controlled change-review/recovery/pending presentation. State and actions are owned by the calling wallet machine.
Pure rendering of existing direct-transfer or vault-payment records. Does not submit or mutate records.
Pure payment-row/amount rendering with actions delegated to stateful parent/consent components.
Pure display of imported approved scoring/penalty tables. No state or mutation.
Controlled form field presentation; values and event handling belong to the parent draft machine.
Pure rendering of the supplied cycle allocation and reviewer rows. Scoring/projection math has separate domain coverage.
Public explanatory/sponsor rendering derives from supplied registry/snapshot props; no local state/effect or mutation. Child state remains separately modeled.
Controlled network/asset fields; chosen values are owned by parent forms, with no independent persistence or request.
Pure rendering of supplied bounty terms and amounts. No action or independent state.
Stateless digest operation over an owned byte view; callers own asynchronous completion and trust decisions.
Pure decimal text and bigint formatting/parsing helpers with no I/O, storage or lifecycle. These functions do not establish whether any amount is funded or paid.
Pure byte/text encoding with per-call local accumulators; no retained state or side effects.
Pure byte/base64 conversion and buffer-copy helpers; protocol/session state belongs to callers.
Recursive deterministic serialization over the supplied value; no retained state or I/O.
Pure immutable actor-ID/kind eligibility predicate; no retained state or I/O. Accepted-source lifecycle is owned by the ledger.
Static public contact constants; no transitions.
Static labels and derived field arrays; no retained state, events, requests or mutations.
Pure deployment-tier/origin selection and local-origin predicate; no runtime effect or transition.
Pure error-to-message projection; caller owns error state and recovery.
Pure canonical URL, archive, identity and evidence validation. External award admission owns the state transition; archive retrieval and content truth are not established by this parser.
Per-call Markdown/JSON parser with a newly created regex; no state retained between parses.
Pure label predicate over supplied time, cycle state and amount; no retained state or independent lifecycle.
Pure canonical node-ID decoding and stable actor sorting. No retained state or I/O; format equivalence is consumed by exclusion/admission models.
Static icon geometry and pure component creation; no user/application state.
Pure parsing of an explicit configuration value into an ID set; it does not mutate authority or publish state.
Pure canonical work-key derivation from validated repository records and URL; no state mutation or I/O.
Pure filters over the immutable runtime registry and bounty status. Registry transitions are owned by project policy/boot models.
Pure bounded metadata response parser; no retained state, request or mutation.
Types and literal enum arrays only; no retained state, I/O, lifecycle or mutation. Admission and aggregation contracts are modeled at consuming functions.
Static network-label projection; no network calls, balances or state transitions.
Pure response/cursor validation and labels. Read, acknowledgement and delivery transitions are owned by Inbox/backend; no independent retained state.
Pure decimal-string to bounded base-unit parsing. No mutable lifecycle; transaction amount and asset identities remain governed by their payment models.
Static guide rows derived from the canonical Slopbot penalty table. This projection has no state transition; penalty application, reversal and funded-award preservation remain modeled elsewhere.
One immutable configured recipient constant; no state transition.
Pure structural and total/order validation of a supplied summary object; no publication or journal mutation. Points journal and source publication state remain separate models.
Pure UTC-day bucketing and summed Point amounts from arguments; no retained state, I/O, lifecycle or mutation.
Pure capability/reason projection from supplied registration, restriction, funding and retired facts. No authority-grant mutation; owning API gates are modeled separately.

Domain type declarations, static route constants and pure GitHub identity/path parsing or display copy. No authority lookup, revision mutation or RPC; corresponding service models own those transitions.
Pure bounded data-URL and file-signature validation; no retained state, I/O or mutation.
Static re-export of the build-time registry input, distinct from runtime registry; no independent state or effect.
Pure presentation projection of supplied registry reward/bounty fields; no storage or asynchronous work. Project lifecycle and payment state are not established by this display helper.

Pure supplied-response shape/arithmetic validator and reviewed USD-asset predicate. No fetch, mutable cache or payment transition; actual receipt indexing and public aggregation remain payment ledger responsibilities.
Pure record/key/string/integer/time validation primitives; no retained state or I/O.

Pure amount formatting and funded/unfunded labels from supplied fields; no stored state, I/O or transition. Input funding truth is owned by the allocation/registry flow, and formatting is not a proof of funding.

Pure reward-asset choice construction, schema validation and same-object comparison. No I/O or persistent state. Authoritative asset verification and activation remain registry/chain state transitions and are not exempted here.
Pure lookup of a supplied project's exact cycle cap override; no mutation or rollover state. Cap enforcement remains in monthly allocation and vault models.

Pure construction and preview of an unverified bounty proposal from form inputs. No submission, approval, funding or payment occurs in this module; those state transitions remain API and bounty model responsibilities.
Pure preservation of existing security terms/default split while rebuilding form fields; state is owned by the editor.
Per-call digest computation using the detected hashing runtime; no application state retained across calls.
Pure canonical padded-base64 decoder with 64-byte length and round-trip check. No signature verification, challenge consumption, signing or stored state.
Static canonical source repository URL; no transitions.
Seven pure argument-to-result decisions with explicit preconditions/postconditions; no retained state, request, timer, storage or mutation. Caller workflows remain in the corresponding UI models.

Pure bigint arithmetic kernels for weighted shares and ordinary/bounty fees. No I/O, mutation or lifecycle; precondition proofs are separate from state refinement and callers enforce input admissibility.
Only types and literal status arrays for assessment/clearance/journal records. No runtime transition or I/O.
Type declarations only for immutable wallet evidence; emitted JavaScript has no runtime state or transitions.
Pure address validation, equality, byte conversion and shortened display. No claim storage, consent or authorization mutation; actual wallet registration/binding remains modeled and is not exempted.

Pure bigint rounding, slippage, remaining-cap, rescaling, spendable balance and gas/impact arithmetic. No quote fetch, signing, journal or payment state; those transitions remain fee conversion models.

Literal staging identity bindings and separate limiter namespaces with staging environment. No own state transition; same identity/admission models apply, while live deployment wiring remains separately verified.

Literal identity domain/D1, rate limits and reporting refresh cron. OAuth and request-rate transitions are in api_identity/api_identity_admission; reporting freshness in api_reporting_readiness. No script mutates configuration here.

Literal service-only email binding, fixed sender and empty default schedule; destination secrets are not checked in. api_mail_delivery and bot_notice_delivery cover send/claim states; explicit pilot release creates its own schedule outside this file.

Pure deterministic Merkle leaf/tree/proof calculation over supplied amounts and addresses; no external state or root posting. This classification does not claim cryptographic correctness or replace the distributor state machine.

Only re-exports the default worker and named RPC entrypoint classes. Request, scheduled and queue transitions are in index.ts; private import and readiness transitions are in the exported implementations.

Literal staging service/D1 binding configuration, no own transition. Repository access and private historical publishing are modeled in bot_repository_access and bot_historical_import; model does not prove deployed binding isolation.

Literal deployment bindings, five-minute cron, queue limits and closure-off default; no own runtime transition. Review/queue/admission behavior is in bot_moderation, bot_webhook_delivery, bot_value_request; deploying these settings remains an operational gate.

Four pure policy predicates/arithmetic functions with Lemma annotations. They read only explicit arguments and hold no mutable state, I/O, clock or authorization cache. Closure, penalty, specialist and referral callers retain state and evidence gates in their own models.
Literal staging backup bindings with both modes off and queue concurrency1. No own transition; backup/retention and qualification models cover callers, not deployed resource ownership.

Literal private backup/D1/R2/queue/cron configuration with backup and retention off. vetting_backup_chain/vetting_retention cover runtime state; queue concurrency1 does not replace their persistence constraints.
Literal staging sandbox/container bindings with no public route. No own transition; merge/execution models cover callers while deployment and actual container isolation need separate evidence.

Literal private sandbox container binding and durable-object class migration; no branching runtime. Isolation/cleanup transitions are in vetting_execution_provenance/vetting_merge_isolation and operational release models; values alone do not prove sandboxing.

Static Pages bindings, environment constants and isolated preview declarations. No executable transition; API composition and service release models describe consumers. This configuration is not evidence of hosted binding availability.
